messages:
Mira Collins: Quick thread to finalize the customer case for next-week launch. Deliverables: short social pull, 1-pager, 15s clip, webinar mention. Who owns what?
Samir Gupta: I can own copy + interview brief. Need the final KPIs from infra.
Jules Park: I have infra numbers: ~36% token cost reduction, P95 improved ~40ms. Dropping screenshots to /files/bench/launch_jun.
Mira Collins: Nice. For social keep it qualitative; put the 36% stat in the one-pager only.
LegalBot: Consent required. Use this text exactly: I consent to Redwood Inference using my quote, company name, and logo in marketing materials for this launch. I confirm these materials are not designated as confidential in writing. Also capture signer name, title, and date.
Samir Gupta: Draft social pull: "Redwood made our inference reliable and much cheaper 1 a real enabler for product." Thoughts?
Jules Park: Customer wants to preview the exact pull quote 24 hours before publish. They also want a trademark approval line in the consent.
Mira Collins: Noted. Ops, can you add routing rules so demo leads go to SFDC ENT-214 and add hidden form field deployment_interest with options hosted/dedicated/private? Also add UTM utm_campaign=launch_case.
OpsBot: Routing and form updated. Webhook (test): https://hooks.redwood.ai/test/ent-214. UTM params added.
Samir Gupta: Recording scheduled Wed 3pm PT (10min). Requesting customer to record a 10s candid intro + 8s b-roll.
LegalBot: Once signed, email signed PDF to legal@redwood.ai with signer name/title/timestamp.
Mira Collins: OK team 1 plan: Samir will send final quote to customer Tue AM, get signature Wed AM, record Wed 3pm, LaunchBot to kick off assets after upload. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
LaunchBot: Asset checklist created and will trigger on consent upload. Will post to #marketing-live on publish.
file_note: compact customer case planning: consent, routing, assets
